subject.title: fix(cron): expose flat cron job fields and normalize malformed tool args

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's flat cron schema as a supported model-facing path for model, fallbacks, toolsAllow, and shell-field rejection semantics?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but making provider/model override and tool allow-list fields easier for models to set is a durable product and security-boundary choice.

options.title: Accept the narrow flat path
options.body: Merge after exact-head CI if maintainers are comfortable supporting these recoverable flat fields in the cron tool schema.

options.title: Narrow provider/tool fields first
options.body: Keep schedule/message flat recovery but remove or gate model, fallbacks, and toolsAllow until the boundary is settled.

options.title: Defer to cron-tool redesign
options.body: Pause this branch in favor of per-action cron tools if maintainers do not want broader flat schema support on the existing tool.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow flat path
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head CI if maintainers are comfortable supporting these recoverable flat fields in the cron tool schema.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent history on shared cron flat recovery and adjacent gateway/security-scope work.
